retirement_rule: A retirement row is emitted only when all of the following hold: (a) the operation's stable identity (file, kind, enclosing item) is absent from the current per-site inventory at inventory_source_head; (b) the deleting commit's diff removes exactly that definition; (c) the coordinate the previous applied closure enumerated now holds a different item, or holds nothing. A retirement row carries no span_sha256 and asserts no contract; it records non-existence.

supersedes_note: The loader (consumer_closure.load_boundaries) admits this file because its kind is 'site-enumerating-boundary-receipt' and its name matches '*-sites.json'; it attaches this receipt's supersedes id list to every boundary this receipt declares. That machinery, however, resolves only same-operation disposition conflicts (adjudicate, conflicting-disposition) and cannot remove a carried-forward obligation. It does not read carry_forward_retirements.

consumption.loader_admission: consumer_closure.load_boundaries (glob '*-sites.json' + kind == SITE_RECEIPT_KIND); CLI flag not required: --boundary-dir defaults to forensics/memory-safety/campaign/safe-c33/atlas-refresh
consumption.disposition_effect: none: every boundary here has disposition 'ELIMINATED (...)', so boundary_disposition_is_discharge is false and no site can be discharged from this receipt
consumption.carry_forward_effect: none by itself: carry_forward_candidates() matches a previous obligation against the current per-site inventory by stable identity (file, kind, item) and falls back to by_exact (file, line, kind) when no stable-identity row is found (forensics/tools/consumer_closure.py:27491-27493). At b76 the four deleted operations are absent by identity but the by_exact fallback matches the DIFFERENT items now occupying lines 376/380/384/388, so the tool reports them as present and cannot add them at either coordinate (obligation_candidates, :27911-27918), producing CARRY_FORWARD_SUPPRESSED. A tool-level guard (require the by_exact row's item to be the same item, or empty) is required before this record can change the closure verdict.
consumption.flag: there is no retirement/supersession CLI flag; the only census-driven exit is carry_forward_candidates' 'removed' path, which the by_exact fallback defeats here
